doc.title: Marty Morell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017

title: Peter Pettinger's praise of Morell
summary: Rowe reads a review calling Morell an unsung stalwart of piano trio history.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: Have you read this Peter Pettinger? What he said about you? “Unsung stalwart of piano trio history.” That’s you. “Responsible for an exceedingly tight unit that could swing and drive relentlessly. His control of the 12-bar sections in a number like ‘Twelve Tone Tune’ for instance, snappy and precise as could be.”
All right I remember that, snappy. © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-
